thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SEV2 — inference-gateway 5xx error-rate spike in prod-us-west2. 5xx rate=7.8% (threshold=1%). Triggers: latency and error-rate monitors. PagerDuty incident #PD-83421 fired.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-83421 assigned to @Alice Chen (on-call).

Alice Chen: Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage.

Samir Patel: I'll pull gateway logs and check recent deploys.

Maya Gomez: I'll look at downstream model-serving pools (gpu-pool-a).

Alice Chen: Initial hit: /v1/generate is returning 502/504 from gateway -> model-proxy. Region=prod-us-west2. Errors started ~1793001200.

Ravi Singh: Any recent config or cert rollouts? I deployed a small routing tweak ~1793000000 but that was us-east1-only.

Samir Patel: Logs (filtered):
```
[1793001235] upstream_502: "GET /v1/generate" host=inference-gw worker=gw-12 upstream=model-proxy-3 status=502 recv=0ms
[1793001240] kvcache_miss route=heavy-tenant id=tx-9f2a err=broken_pipe
[1793001245] rate_limit: tenant=acme-pay spike=3.2x
```
Maya Gomez: gpu-pool-a shows 100% queue depth on a subset of replicas; model-proxy instances hitting OOM-kills? Checking metrics.

oncall-rotation-bot: @Alice Chen, you have an on-call handoff scheduled in 45m. If incident persists, escalate to @Samir Patel.

Alice Chen: Noted. Priorities: 1) stabilize traffic 2) reduce customer impact 3) identify root cause.

Samir Patel: Quick mitigation — enable model-proxy fallback route to smaller quantized model and enable autoscale extra replicas in us-west2. Applying now.

ops-bot: Command executed: `kubectl patch deployment model-proxy -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":10}}'`

Alice Chen: Also temporarily throttle large tenants showing high qps. @Maya can you add a soft limit for 10m?

Maya Gomez: Adding quota for tenant acme-pay: `rate_limit 200r/s` applied via gateway.

Samir Patel: Rolling traffic to fallback model v2-small. Patch to routing table applied.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in progress: fallback model enabled, replicas scaled + throttles applied. Monitoring for recovery.

Alice Chen: Customer impact: affecting ~0.9% of requests overall but concentrated to top 5 tenants. Acme-pay main payment flow saw 15% failures from 18:40–18:45 PDT. Notifying SRE on pager.

Ravi Singh: I see a pattern: proxy to model-proxy-3 lagging; connection reset by peer in tcp stats. Could be kernel-level ephemeral port exhaustion on proxy hosts. Checking sysctl.

Samir Patel: I can repro locally with a high-QPS spike; the proxy's keepalive backlog fills and it starts returning 502. Reverting keepalive config change from this morning might help.

Alice Chen: Do it. What's the config key?

Samir Patel: nginx `keepalive_requests` was reduced to 100 in morning rollback. Setting back to 1000. Command: `kubectl exec -it nginx-gw -- sed -i 's/keepalive_requests 100;/keepalive_requests 1000;/' && kubectl rollout restart deploy/nginx-gw`

ops-bot: Deploy command queued.

Maya Gomez: After throttles + fallback + scale, 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% at 1793001400. Still above target but trending down.

Alice Chen: Good. Ops, apply kernel tuning on model-proxy hosts as a durable fix (somaxconn, tcp_tw_reuse). Ravi, coordinate with infra to push sysctl.

Ravi Singh: Will prepare sysctl change and a canary rollout to two hosts.

oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: If incident not resolved before handoff, escalate per policy to infra oncall.

Alice Chen: I'll keep the channel updated. Samir, Maya — great work. Plan: maintain throttles for 30m, monitor SLA dashboards, prepare a short customer-facing note for support if errors persist.

Samir Patel: Patch completed, nginx-gw rolled, model-proxy replicas stable, no further OOMs.

Maya Gomez: 5xx rate down to 0.4% at 1793001520. Latency back to baseline.

Alice Chen: PD incident PD-83421 -> status: mitigated. Keeping the channel open for postmortem.

incident-bot: PD-83421 acknowledged by Alice Chen. Marking as mitigated. Please file follow-up: owner=Ravi Singh, action=kernel-tuning+postmortem, timeframe=24h.

Alice Chen: Filing postmortem ticket now and assigning Ravi. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
